Fonseca and colleagues (71) demonstrated the importance of varying exercise selection in a study in which they compared muscular adaptations following performance of the Smith machine squat with a volume-equated combination of the Smith machine squat, leg press, lunge, and deadlift. Results showed that the varied exercise routine produced more uniform muscle hypertrophy of all four quadriceps muscles compared to performing the Smith machine squat alone.
